definitions.mac_array: Native service including DRAM array operand reads; not isolated ALU time.
definitions.array_column: Native same-array column-spacing guard after MACK service: [issue+2 CK, issue+4 CK), intersected with pipeline phases. An attribution window, not an additional independently summed transfer latency.
definitions.bg_reduction: Four-bank local reduction is provisioned to keep pace with MAC_QK; a zero separate event column is not a measured zero physical delay.
definitions.multicast: WRGB and Q relay use command-level traffic and readiness; no added fanout-dependent network delay.
definitions.q_dram_read: Actual native DRAM read issue through data return (nCL+nBL_min), counted once; not GPU input.
definitions.q_broadcast: Controller-to-bank WRGB relay after the Q DRAM read completes. Internal relay payload is not new GPU input. Native WRGB spacing and buffer readiness apply.
definitions.input_window: Native data-service windows (2 CK per 32 B at the baseline); command-spacing gaps remain other unless another resource is active.
definitions.fenced_transfer: Measured phase includes its scheduling, row handling, and explicit tails.
definitions.pipeline: Native service-window union; simultaneous resources are a separate overlap column.
definitions.other: Unattributed elapsed scheduling/ACT/PRE/refresh/recovery/fence gaps; not isolated DRAM stall. Projection and QK MAC service uses 20 CK in this version.
definitions.service_work: Summed work across potentially parallel resources, not additive wall time.
